name: Apartametul afit
beschreibung: Apartametul afit is situated in Lienz, the charming capital of East Tyrol. The apartments are tailored for self-catering stays, each featuring a well-equipped kitchenette and a comfortable living area. Lienz serves as an excellent starting point for mountain adventures and cultural excursions, with the historic town centre within easy walking distance. A wide range of scenic hiking and cycling trails awaits in the surrounding area. This accommodation is an ideal choice for an independent alpine getaway.
